h1: GPS-guided survey line clearing through Texas brush
lede: Survey line clearing in Texas often means cutting an exact line through brush you cannot see across. 9 Arrow mounts Trimble GPS receivers on our forestry mulching machines and follows your licensed surveyor's files in real time, so the line we clear follows the certified survey data.

answer.q: What is precision survey line clearing?
answer.a: Precision survey line clearing is forestry mulching guided by GPS. 9 Arrow loads your licensed surveyor's CAD survey files into Trimble data collectors and receivers mounted on the mulching machine. The operator follows the digital line in real time while clearing, which reduces or eliminates survey-crew pre-staking, even in dense timber.

highlights: Trimble receivers mounted on the mulcher
Follows your surveyor's CAD survey files
Clears lines through dense brush and timber

sections.h2: How survey line clearing works in Texas brush
paras: Survey line clearing at 9 Arrow starts with your surveyor. Your licensed surveyor provides the CAD survey files, and we load them into Trimble geospatial data collectors and receivers mounted on our forestry mulching machines. GPS guidance shows the operator the line in real time, so the machine follows certified survey data through brush nobody can see across.

Thick cedar and oak can hide every flag and stake on a tract. GPS guidance keeps the operator on line where flagging would be hard to find, and the mulcher grinds the trees and brush in place as it goes. The result is a cleared line with no burn piles and nothing to haul.

sections.h2: What precision line clearing saves on a project
paras: Line clearing without GPS often has to wait on a survey crew to walk the line and stake it by hand before a machine can cut. With the survey files loaded on the mulcher, 9 Arrow can reduce or eliminate that pre-staking. On larger projects, skipping that step can save tens of thousands of dollars and cut the delays that come from scheduling crews around each other.

Precision line clearing also keeps the clearing matched to the plan. Lot lines, road corridors and easements are cleared along the approved survey data, which matters when property boundaries, easements and planned infrastructure all have to fit together.
Zach C., a developer, wrote in a five-star Google review, “We exclusively use 9 Arrow for all land clearings, lot lines, and site prep scopes for our Texas projects.”

sections.h2: Where survey line clearing is used
paras: Precision survey line clearing fits any job where the cleared ground has to match a survey. Developers use it to open subdivision street corridors and lot lines. Utility and energy clients use it for easements and pad sites. Landowners use it to clear property lines and fence lines between tracts. Common uses include the following.
bullets: Future road locations through dense timber
Subdivision street corridors and lot lines
Pad sites for oilfield and utility projects

sections.h2: Survey line clearing does not replace your surveyor
paras: 9 Arrow is not a licensed surveyor and does not replace one. Precision survey line clearing depends on certified survey data from your licensed surveyor. Our job is to clear along that data. If your project still needs a survey, the surveyor comes first, and we load the files once they are ready.

faqs.q: Do I still need a surveyor for survey line clearing?
faqs.a: Yes, survey line clearing depends on a licensed surveyor. 9 Arrow is not a licensed surveyor and does not replace one. Your surveyor provides the certified CAD survey files, and we load those files into the Trimble equipment on our mulchers and clear along the data. The surveyor stays responsible for the survey itself.

faqs.q: Can you clear a survey line through dense brush?
faqs.a: Yes, GPS-guided survey line clearing works in dense brush and timber. The operator follows the survey data in real time, so the line does not depend on spotting stakes or flagging through the trees. Clearing future road locations through dense timber is one of the main uses for precision line clearing.

faqs.q: How does survey line clearing save money?
faqs.a: Precision survey line clearing saves money by reducing or eliminating survey-crew pre-staking. Your surveyor's files go straight onto the mulcher, so the line does not have to be staked by hand before clearing starts. On larger projects, that can save tens of thousands of dollars and reduce delays on the schedule.
